name: osdbits-wasm
description: Browser-native Rust/WASM + WebGPU + Web Audio + IndexedDB/OPFS reconstruction of the PlayStation 2 OSDSYS visual experience

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --manifest-path Cargo.toml --package osdbits-core --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && mkdir -p public/wasm && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/osdbits_core.wasm public/wasm/osdbits_core.wasm
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
